notes.title: MONTHLY UPDATES: APRIL
notes.content:
[h1][b]The Occultist: April Updates[/b]👻📿[/h1]

We’re back with another monthly update for The Occultist, and we’ve got some exciting news to share! This time, we’re diving into one of the most essential tools in the game—your [b]Diary[/b]. Plus, we’ve got something HUGE to celebrate: The Occultist has won [b]Best in Play at GDC 2025[/b]!

[h2]📖 The Diary: Your tool for discovering the unknown 📖[/h2]

In The Occultist, investigation is key to uncovering the mysteries of the island. To help you with this, you’ll have access to a Diary. It’s more than just a collection of notes—it’s your personal guide through the secrets of GodStone.

[list]
[*][b]Investigation:[/b] This section records all the relevant information you discover throughout the story. Every found object, important conversation, or crucial detail will be stored here, making it easier to solve puzzles.

[*][b]Story:[/b] As you progress, this section will fill up with details about the events surrounding the island and its mysterious past. It will be crucial for connecting the dots and understanding twhat happened in this lost island.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137475/dd40441aa155e2cb08836a3bcff9f6ef3b819d5d.gif[/img]

This Diary will be your best ally in keeping track of your investigation and fully immersing yourself in the game’s narrative.


[h2][b]🏆 We won the Best in Play at GDC 2025[/b][/h2]

March was an unforgettable month for us. We had the incredible opportunity to showcase The Occultist at the [i]Game Developers Conference[/i] (GDC) 2025, where we met amazing developers and guess what? We took home the [b]Best in Play GDC 2025[/b] award!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137475/caf51597da6bae73b6db5958a2b01314ba5e557a.png[/img]

That’s it for this month’s update! As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts—what do you think about the Diary? 📖 Let us know in the comments!


DALOAR Team

notes.title: THE OCCULTIST NEW GAMEPLAY TRAILER / NACON CONNECT
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As indie developers developing our first game, this is a really special moment for us, and we couldn't be more excited to share it with you. [b]The Occultist[/b] has been featured at [b]Nacon Connect[/b]. To be able to be part of this event alongside so many amazing projects is an honor, and we're incredibly grateful for this opportunity which we would like to thank Daedalic and Nacon for.

After years of hard work, we’re thrilled to finally unveil our [b]NEW Gameplay Trailer[/b]! This latest preview showcases never-before-seen gameplay, deeper horror elements, and an atmospheric experience that we can't wait for you to dive into.

[h3]📽️ Watch the new Nacon Connect presentation:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=PaE-gJvE2e0;full][/previewyoutube]

This trailer is more than just a sneak peek. It’s a reflection of all the passion, and effort that has gone into development of our game. 

In our new trailer you will see:

🏘️ New GodStone locations
🙍‍♂️ Key Characters
📿 New Pendulum Abilities
And much more...

[h3]👀 And check out the full NEW Gameplay Trailer here:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=LloYPdO2exE;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know what you think in the comments, and stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you for being part of this journey with us! 📿

DALOAR Team
